chunk.content: Mozambique tilapia (Oreochromis mossambicus) is processed into fish mince and burger; their quality was evaluated during frozen storage at -18C up to 75 days.
chunk.source_quote: Quality of Tilapia fish mince and burger were determined during frozen storage condition (-18C) up to 75th days.

source.title: Quality evaluation of fish burger from tilapia (Oreochromis mossambicus) during frozen storage (-18°C)
